title: Coherence of fixed normalized completion and tensor families
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l. Suppose completion and tensor assign to every scheme isomorphism f:V→W with l invertible a PodCompletionReindex D_f and a PodCompletedTensorReindex T_f over D_f, and both satisfy their Laws. There exist section-normalized identity and composition isomorphisms of the ordinary module inverse images. With these isomorphisms and the original completion and tensor assignments, the resulting PodReindexFamily satisfies Relabelling, Identity, Composition and TensorConstraints at every f. In particular its reduction, limit and tensor maps are exactly those supplied, and its associator, braiding and unitors are the specified integral ones. Definitions: [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-pod-completion-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-tensor-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization], [def-pod-completion-reindex-coherence], [def-pod-integral-tensor-constraints], [def-pod-isomorphism-reduction-reindexing].

proof.text: use Over.mapId and Over.mapComp on each original local section to define identity and composition of ordinary relabelling. These are module maps because the completed coefficient maps agree after every quotient projection; limit extensionality gives their coefficient equality. Reverse site transports give the inverses. Thus the displayed Relabelling equations hold by construction. On strict quotient complexes, both reduction routes send p tensor b to the same relabeled generator. The limit routes are the same diagonal maps on both Roos coordinates, by the coordinate and restricted-system laws of completion. Localize these equalities to obtain the reduction and limit parts of Identity and Composition. For tensors apply Generators and Model: on homogeneous triples both associator paths send (x tensor y) tensor z to x tensor (y tensor z), and both symmetry paths multiply Fy tensor Fx by (-1)^(pq). The coefficient unit is sent to the coefficient unit; multiplication on tensors gives both unitors. These are equalities of full strict systems and of both Roos coordinates. Naturality and the representative models descend them to the specified derived maps. No choice of new completion or tensor comparisons occurs. The identity, empty-scheme and zero-input cases use the same section formulas. .

lean.statement:
theorem podReindexingTensorFamilyCoherence
    (completion : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)], PodCompletionReindex l E f)
    (tensor : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletedTensorReindex l E f (completion f))
    (hcompletion : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E f (completion f))
    (htensor : ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
      [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
      [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)],
      PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E f (completion f) (tensor f)) :
    ∃ identity : ∀ W : Scheme.{u}, isoReductionIntegralInverse l E (𝟙 W) ≅ 𝟭 _,
    ∃ composition : ∀ {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (f : W ⟶ V)
      [IsIso h] [IsIso f], isoReductionIntegralInverse l E (h ≫ f) ≅
        isoReductionIntegralInverse l E f ⋙ isoReductionIntegralInverse l E h,
      let A : PodReindexFamily l E := ⟨completion, tensor, identity, composition⟩
      A.Relabelling l E ∧ A.Identity l E ∧ A.Composition l E ∧
        ∀ {V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ W) [IsIso f]
          [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
          [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)], A.TensorConstraints l E f
